name: Firo Prochainezo
original_name: フィーロ・プロシェンツォ
source:
Martillo Family executive.
An executive of the Martillo Camorra Family based in New York. He goes to pick up his friend Claire, who is onboard the transcontinental train.

[Translated from in-game profile]
